statement: For every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), define X_i = sum_{j=0}^{i} nums[j] * 2^(i-j). Whenever prefixes_div_by5 nums returns a result r, it holds that len(r) = len(nums) and, for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), r[i] = true if and only if there exists an integer q with X_i = 5*q.

Whenever prefixes_div_by5 nums returns a result r, it holds that rem_0 = nums[0], that rem_{i+1} = (2*rem_i + nums[i+1]) mod 5 for every i with 0 <= i and i+1 < len(nums), and that r[i] = true if and only if rem_i = 0 for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums).
